selection: All subsets fixed by original candidate identities and snapshot text availability, before outcome comparison.
gold_complete_definition: Every original annotated sentence identity has verified text, including claims with no annotated evidence.
all_candidates_complete_definition: All 100 original candidate identities have verified June 2017 snapshot text; this also implies all annotated sentences have verified text in this controlled pool.
prospective: Original fitting, calibration, scoring form, thresholds, tie keys and held-out outcomes remain frozen. Metrics are subset-restricted only.
fixed_budget: Original fitting and score forms remain frozen. Exactly one admitted item per subset held-out query on average, maximum five per query; workload is allocated within each subset. Individual views use raw scores.
recall_denominator: Original annotated sentences per query, averaged over queries with annotated evidence; set recall requires one complete original evidence group.
query_counts: Four overlapping outer partitions; per-partition counts and their mean are reported separately from distinct source queries.
bootstrap: 1000 paired query-cluster draws with common query weights across overlapping partitions. Prospective decisions frozen; fixed-budget allocation repeated in each resample.
